title: A high-tech mug for a farewell gift
prompt: Your team is collecting money for a farewell gift for a coworker who is retiring and drinks tea all day long. In a gift shop at Metrotown, you see this unusual mug. Call the colleague who is organizing the gift, describe the mug in detail, and explain why you think it would or would not be a good choice.

structure: Open the call, state the purpose and give an overall impression of the mug.
Describe the body: white mug, teal stripe, temperature display, two mismatched handles.
Describe the top (grey lid, slot, yellow fan) and the bottom (black heating base, light, cord).
Interpret the features, give the price and a reasoned recommendation.
modelAnswer: Hi Daniel, it's Farah. I'm at Metrotown, and I think I may have stumbled on the perfect send-off present for Margaret. It's a tall white mug with a wide teal stripe near the bottom, and on the front there's a black display reading 65 degrees, so it shows how hot your tea is. Oddly enough, it has two handles that don't match: the one on the left is red and rounded, whereas the one on the right is blue and square. It's topped with a grey, dome-shaped lid with a narrow slot to sip through, and sticking out of the lid there's a tiny yellow fan with three blades, presumably to cool the tea down. The whole mug sits on a black heating plate with an orange light, and a cord trails off to the right. So, ironically, it can warm your tea up and cool it down. It's $54.95, which fits our budget. It's a bit gimmicky, but given how much tea Margaret drinks, I think she'd get a real kick out of it. Shall I pick it up?

commonMistakes: Đọc '65°C' thành 'sixty-five C'; nên nói 'sixty-five degrees' và giải thích ý nghĩa.
Chỉ nói 'two handles' mà không nêu sự khác biệt (màu, hình dạng) — ở mức 9 cần tả chi tiết so sánh.
Liệt kê bộ phận mà không suy luận công dụng (quạt để làm nguội, đế để giữ ấm) và không đưa ra khuyến nghị rõ ràng.
